method: Recovery = from a phone detecting link/session loss (or its Emergency mode restarting) to that SAME phone's next completed Noise XX handshake, both on its own elapsedRealtimeNanos. Each cycle is verified afterwards with probes. Raw: bench_phone_*/bench/events_*.jsonl, lifecycle_log.txt.

cases.case: Noise session killed by a tampered frame (fault switch), 6 cycles alternating A/B
cases.root_cause: stale server link on a reused LE connection ignored the new CCCD; server stuck at MTU 23; duplicate rule kept a dead link and cancelConnection killed the peer's re-dial

cases.case: Noise session killed by a tampered frame, 6 cycles alternating A/B
Bluetooth off 6-8 s then on, on PHONE_B
cases.result: cycle 2 crashed PHONE_A's app (uncaught LinkClosedException); a later run left one cycle with probes 0/3 on a stale link and several Noise timeouts

cases.case: Bluetooth off 8 s then on, on PHONE_B, 3 cycles
cases.result: 3/3 recovered with exactly one session per side, 9/9 probes, MTU 517, 0 link failures, 0 Noise failures, 0 uncaught exceptions

cases.case: PHONE_A app force-stopped and relaunched (am start -S), 2 cycles
PHONE_A deliberately closes its sessions (drop_links), 2 cycles
PHONE_A sent to HOME (backgrounded) during bidirectional traffic
cases.result: 5/5 B->A and 5/5 A->B delivered within ~24 s; foreground service stayed running
cases.not_tested: screen off: KEYCODE_SLEEP did not turn the screen off (phone stayed Awake on USB); device settings were not changed

cases.case: Clean cold start of both apps (radio gate)
cases.result: PHONE_B (GATT client), its own clock from Emergency on: peer discovered 90 ms, GATT connected 1496 ms, services 1804 ms, MTU 517 at 1925 ms, CCCD 2043 ms, HELLO/READY 2164 ms, Noise XX done 2471 ms (handshake 305 ms). PHONE_A (server) handshake 303 ms.
